title: Pullback compositor transport for the open projection square
statement: For a compactification c=(i,g) and coefficient change, the pullback compositor for i then g transports the open projection coefficient square to the displayed f-square. The two component equations separately transport the source and target composites and contain no open projection mate.

proof.text: Apply scalarPull_geometric_composition and transport along the compactification triangle. Expand projectionOpenFactor, move the tensor of the pullback compositor through openComparison and scalarTensor by naturality, and apply the scalar composition equation. This proves the first component. For the second component, use naturality of the inverse open projection isomorphism (hence of its hom), and commute the two independent morphisms in the product category before applying the tensor functor.

proof_origin.note: Naturality transport and a separate tensor-free scalar/geometric compositor equation.
